messages:
mina: Quick flag 8:07 A customer noticed fncall validation rejects are incrementing /chat.generate quota. Seems tied to our routing pipeline change.

tariq: can you paste request id?

mina: req a1d4b2, 2026-03-01T08:06:45Z. validator returned "invalid_function_output" and console shows /chat.generate.

elena: TL;DR we moved route-resolve after validation in the streaming work so early failures get default route.

mina: impact small but affects chargeback for a dedicated customer. Ops: any counts?

ops-bot: dry-run: 2026-03-01T00:00 -> 2026-03-01T12:00 UTC, predicate "validation.error_kind:invalid_function_output AND billing.route:'/chat.generate'" => 57 matches.

tariq: options: 1) revert route-resolve order, 2) populate x-route-hint at ingress and teach validator to prefer it, 3) post-process billing (bad). Prefer #2. low-risk, reversible.

elena: agree. i'll add x-route-hint population in auth middleware and update validator to consult header when tagging error events. will gate behind ff `preserve-route-before-validate` and add unit + e2e.

mina: short-term shim? maybe validator can map invalid_function_output to /fncall if header missing, behind ff. reduces misbills while canary runs.

ops-bot: note: any server-side change must be canaried 10% hosted/dedicated. Also billing team: please generate CSV of affected reqs for reconciliation.

billing-team: will produce CSV and hold on reconciliation until we confirm canary results.

tariq: cool. PR incoming today. I'll include telemetry change: validation errors will include route_hint in payload so downstream processors can remap safely.

mina: thanks. once PR merges i'll post a short status for support and add a temporary dashboard alert (>2 mislabels/hr).
